answer: In an agent marketplace trading meadow surveys and yarrow forecasts, each agent must lock a fixed bond before accepting paid jobs. A verifiable failure to deliver forfeits that bond, and withdrawal takes 30 days. Even at the zenith of demand, creating more names grants no free capacity: an attacker running 1,000 identities must fund 1,000 bonds, tying up capital and risking its loss on each fraudulent job.
